description: One loaded catalog holding one entry per SHAPE a LocalizedString can take: plain, commented, a value-based LanguageFormTranslation, a range-based one, a generated ExpressionTranslation fragment with an alternative, and a whole-message alternative. Every `define` case hands a hand-built probe to DefaultStrings$LocalizedStringSet.contains against this catalog, so each field of LocalizedString#equals and of the four nested equals methods has both an EQUAL row and a row where exactly that field differs. Nothing here is degenerate: the fixture loads and constructs like any other, because the hand-built side lives in the case input rather than in the fixture -- which is why `define` needs no construction exemption and no permutation gate, unlike `construct`. Single locale, so tiebreakers is null.
